userRequest: Choose an in-process rate limiter for login attempts on the existing single-replica API.
successConditions: The API limits attempts by normalized account identifier and source address.
The limiter returns remaining quota and retry timing without adding a network service.

identityFacts: The login route normalizes account identifiers before rate-limit evaluation.
dataFacts: Rate-limit counters are operational data and may reset on a planned process restart.
operationalFacts: The customer-controlled installation has one API process and no external network dependency is allowed.

hardConstraints.statement: The limiter must run locally without a hosted or separately operated data service.
The integration must work in Fastify without adapting Express middleware.

preferences.statement: Prefer a library with a future shared-store path if the deployment later gains replicas.

reasonCodes.description: The installation cannot send counter data to an external service.
The candidate integrates without an Express middleware dependency.
An atomic in-memory limiter meets the single-process topology.
The candidate exposes key-based quota and retry state for login protection.

unknowns.description: Security review has not independently accepted counter reset during planned restart.
